classification.difficultyReason: Read two dot plots, calculate the named statistics and compare completion times and consistency.

content.prompt: Compare the range, mean, mode, and median of these two datasets.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 8, upper right dot plot labelled Male.
spec.description: Black circular observation markers above a horizontal axis with integer ticks 27–36. Male is centred below the tick labels. Preserve the same horizontal scale as the Female plot.
spec.mathematics: Frequencies at values 27–36, in order: 4, 3, 4, 4, 5, 3, 4, 4, 6, 3. There are 40 observation markers. No vertical axis, grid or axis arrow is printed.
spec.answerVisibility: All markers, ticks and the Male label are permanent student-visible givens. No answer annotations are included.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 8, lower right dot plot labelled Female.
spec.description: Black circular observation markers above a horizontal axis with integer ticks 27–36. Female is centred below the tick labels. Preserve the same horizontal scale as the Male plot, including the empty positions at 35 and 36.
spec.mathematics: Frequencies at values 27–36, in order: 5, 7, 7, 4, 3, 1, 2, 1, 0, 0. There are 30 observation markers. No vertical axis, grid or axis arrow is printed.
spec.answerVisibility: All markers, ticks and the Female label are permanent student-visible givens. No answer annotations are included.

answer.worked:
Range is the greatest value minus the least value.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Male range}&=36-27\\\text{Male range}&=9\text{ min}\\\text{Female range}&=34-27\\\text{Female range}&=7\text{ min}\end{align*}$$

Mean is the total divided by the number of data values. Each dot represents one time.

Male: $40$ dots.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Total}&=4\times27+3\times28+4\times29+4\times30+5\times31+3\times32+4\times33+4\times34+6\times35+3\times36\\\text{Total}&=1265\text{ min}\\\bar{x}&=\frac{1265}{40}\\\bar{x}&=31.625\text{ min}\end{align*}$$

Female: $30$ dots.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Total}&=5\times27+7\times28+7\times29+4\times30+3\times31+1\times32+2\times33+1\times34\\\text{Total}&=879\text{ min}\\\bar{x}&=\frac{879}{30}\\\bar{x}&=29.3\text{ min}\end{align*}$$

answer.short: Mode: Male: $35$ min; Female: $28$ and $29$ min.
answer.worked:
The mode is the value with the greatest frequency.

Male: $35$ min occurs $6$ times, more often than any other value.

Female: $28$ min and $29$ min each occur $7$ times, so both are modes.

Read the dots in ascending order along the horizontal axis.

Male: $40$ values.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Position}&=\frac{40+1}{2}\\\text{Position}&=20.5\end{align*}$$

There are $20$ values at or below $31$. The 20th value is $31$ and the 21st value is $32$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Median}&=\frac{31+32}{2}\\\text{Median}&=31.5\text{ min}\end{align*}$$

Female: $30$ values.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Position}&=\frac{30+1}{2}\\\text{Position}&=15.5\end{align*}$$

There are $12$ values below $29$ and $19$ values at or below $29$. The 15th and 16th values are both $29$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Median}&=\frac{29+29}{2}\\\text{Median}&=29\text{ min}\end{align*}$$

inlines.text: The dataset is the time taken (in minutes) to complete a test.
Make a comment comparing the two datasets.
Refer to the summary statistics you’ve just calculated.

answer.short: Females took less time on average: mean $29.3$ min versus $31.625$ min, and median $29$ min versus $31.5\text{ min}$. Their times were more consistent, with range $7\text{ min}$ versus $9$ min.
answer.worked: For these datasets, females took less time on average: their mean is $29.3$ min compared with $31.625$ min for males, and their median is $29$ min compared with $31.5$ min. Their modal times, $28$ and $29$ min, are also below the male mode of $35$ min. Their smaller range, $7$ min compared with $9$ min, indicates more consistent completion times.
